name: Australian Government Policy for the responsible use of AI (DTA v2.1)
source: Digital Transformation Agency, Policy for the responsible use of AI in government v2.1 (paraphrased; compliance review required before customer use). Requirement IDs follow the SentRAI AU gap analysis.
changelog: 2.1.0 (Phase 2, E2.1): first version. Opt-in; applies only to organisations that enable it in governance settings.
2.1.0 (Phase 3): SO-1 transparency statement reads the disclosure register, behind its flag (advisory).

gap.missing: Answer the Appendix C in-scope questions in an impact assessment that includes the au-dta questionnaire, and sign it.
gap.not_assessed: The Australia pack is not switched on.

clauses.name: Usage pattern and domain classified
clauses.gap: Record the DTA usage pattern and domain in the model's context profile (missing: {missing}).

clauses.name: On the AI use case register

evidence.pass: Registered with risk rating {risk} and an accountable owner

clauses.name: Accountable use case owner
clauses.gap: Name an accountable use case owner (a person) for this in-scope use case.

clauses.name: Impact assessment for an in-scope use case

gap.missing: In-scope use cases need a signed AI use case impact assessment, revalidated after material change.
gap.not_assessed: Impact assessments are not switched on.

clauses.name: High-risk: risks and mitigations reported to the accountable official

evidence.pass: {assessed} risk(s) assessed; all accepted or within appetite

gap.empty: Record and assess the risks of this high-risk use case so the accountable official sees the rating, mitigations and residual risk.
gap.unaccepted: Residual risks above appetite need acceptance by the approver the risk appetite names.

clauses.name: High-risk use case reported to the DTA
clauses.gap: Once deployment is decided, record the high-risk use case report to the DTA (made through the accountable official).

clauses.name: High-risk use case reviewed at least every 12 months

gap.missing: High-risk use cases need a signed review (impact assessment) at least every {months} months.
gap.stale: Last review {last_review} is older than {months} months.

clauses.name: Deployed use case monitored
clauses.gap: Monitor and evaluate the deployed use case (drift evaluation within the recency window).

clauses.name: Accountable official designated
clauses.gap: Designate an accountable official on the Accountability tab and notify the DTA of the designation.

clauses.name: AI use case register shared with the DTA

evidence.overdue: Register last shared {last_shared}, more than {months} months ago

clauses.gap: Share the AI use case register with the DTA at least every {months} months and record the share.

clauses.name: Responsible AI training for staff

evidence.pass: {compliant} of {staff} staff in date; none overdue
evidence.fail: {overdue} staff overdue on mandatory AI training

clauses.gap: Run mandatory responsible-AI training for all staff and record completions.

clauses.name: Staff informed about Australia's AI Ethics Principles

evidence.pass: {completed} acknowledgement(s) of the AI Ethics Principles
evidence.missing: No course on the AI Ethics Principles

clauses.gap: Add a course or acknowledgement with topic au_ethics_principles for staff who design and implement AI use cases.

clauses.name: AI transparency statement published and reviewed annually

gap.review_overdue: The transparency statement (published {published}) is past its review date.

clauses.name: Incidents handled with senior sign-off and notice to affected people

gap.no_sign_off: {count} serious incident(s) were closed without senior executive sign-off.
gap.not_notified: {count} serious incident(s) have no record that affected people were told.
gap.not_assessed: Incident extensions are not switched on.
